reasons.invalid_polygon: The area shape is invalid. Draw it without crossing edges.
reasons.outside_city: The area extends outside the city.
reasons.too_large: The area is too large (limit: {{limit}} km²).
reasons.on_water: An area entirely over the sea cannot be developed. Draw it so that it reaches land.
reasons.no_land_overlap: Draw the area so that it overlaps the land (otherwise a strip of sea is left between the shore and the area).
reasons.overlaps_parcel: The area overlaps an existing land parcel.
reasons.overlaps_path: The area overlaps a road, track, or other path.
reasons.overlaps_water: The area touches a river or lake.
reasons.overlaps_quay_band: The area overlaps the quay of reclaimed land.
reasons.invalid_height_offset: The height is out of range (up to ±{{offsetLimit}} m).
reasons.below_sea_level: The height cannot be set below sea level.
reasons.too_narrow: The area is too narrow; nothing is left to fill inside the quay.
reasons.no_work: The ground is already at the target height, so no work is needed.
reasons.insufficient_funds: Insufficient funds to place this order.
